try-main.text: Left: one row a role. Right: what the button does, the button, and Quick hire for any site. Click a “Leave out who asks for” control to open the demand list.

try-changepicks.text: “Change picks” opens one role over the page. Tick or untick someone: the count updates. Part-time is left out by default for shop roles.

try-quickhire.text: Quick hire: role, site, how many, skill, demands to leave out. The best matches are picked; one confirm hires them. Replaces the HQ and warehouse table.

try-review.text: Click a site row to open or close its people.

try-gates.text: Picks still work from the save; only the button is disabled, with the fix beside it.

try-phone.text: Summary card, roles as rows, Quick hire as a button, the main button in a bar at the bottom.

try-phonequick.text: Quick hire at phone width: the same card as a page.
